hero_sentence: Interested in the logic of complex systems and the use of AI to understand and solve real-world problems.
about_content_1: As an engineering graduate from EPITA Lyon, I specialize in artificial intelligence and graph-based systems. What drives me most is the underlying logic of our world: understanding how complex systems emerge, evolve, and interact, and how intelligence can be modeled and replicated.
about_content_2: Through my projects and practical experience, I aim to move beyond simple prediction to explore how artificial intelligence can serve as a genuine tool for understanding, forecasting, and decision-making. I learn by building: each project is an opportunity to experiment, tackle real-world challenges, and continuously improve.
about_content_3: Naturally curious, I constantly strive to expand my knowledge and explore new machine learning approaches. Whether in deep learning, natural language processing, computer vision, or data analysis, I seek to master the core principles behind techniques in order to design complete, robust, and impactful systems.
about_content_4: I am particularly interested in the evolution of AI systems capable of reasoning, adapting, and collaborating with humans to solve complex real-world problems. My goal is to drive meaningful impact while continuing to learn, build, and push my limits in this rapidly evolving field.
contact_message: I'm always open to discussing new projects, creative ideas or opportunities.
more_project: More projects are on the way. Some are already finished, but they need a public version before going live.
